sharding.rule: Every cell belongs to exactly one ordered shard; shard boundaries are deterministic from global cell index and never from hidden truth.
sharding.axis_binding: Each shard records ordered cell-id digest, feature/address digest, source counts and donor counts.
sharding.merge_gate: Concatenated ordered cell axes must equal the frozen global cell registry exactly; duplicates, omissions or reordering fail.

required_measurements_before_medium_or_f: bytes per ATAC fragment record after compression
resource_model.rule: Use measured SMALL_CI/stress receipts to update estimates. Never infer full-scale safety from cell count alone.

forbidden: change scientific generator semantics by scale
use a different missingness/control/observation model at full scale
drop difficult source/operator strata to fit hardware
declare sufficient disk/RAM without a measured resource receipt
